text:
lina: Postmortem action: we need an agreed pattern for customer-facing communications when we see repeated latency/timeouts. Who takes ownership of the status page entry vs the detailed customer brief?

ben: I can do the status page notice. Plan: 2-3 line summary, "what happened/impact", what we're doing next, and a link to the customer brief.

omar: I'll produce the customer brief template (non-technical summary + what we changed + next steps). Want it short enough for non-technical readers.

carey: Legal asks that we state whether a full RCA will be shared and under what conditions. Suggest: public summary for affected customers; full RCA only on request and after redaction.

lina: Good. Timeline proposal: initial acknowledgement within 90 minutes, a preliminary customer brief within 24 hours, and final RCA (if applicable) within 7 business days. Thoughts?

ben: 90 mins + 24 hours + 7 days seems reasonable for this class of incident. Avoid promising exact restore times.

omar: I'll include a short "recurrence note" in the brief if this matches a pattern. Customers appreciate seeing we're fixing systemic issues.

carey: Redaction checklist draft: strip internal hostnames, unique customer identifiers, API keys, and proprietary config snippets. Security approval required before any full RCA release.

ben: Draft status page blurb below, feedback please:
```
We are investigating intermittent inference timeouts affecting a subset of API requests.
Impact: Some requests may see increased latency or timeouts.
Mitigation: Temporary fallback routing and capacity increases applied.
Next update: within ~90 minutes.
Customer brief: published within 24 hours.
RCA availability: public summary for affected customers; full RCA available on request after redaction review.
```

lina: Nice. Tweak: change "temporary" to "immediate" mitigations and remove the tilde in "~90 minutes" (use 'within 90 minutes').

omar: I'll prepare the customer brief template and add an engineer-friendly appendix (internal only) so we can speed up redaction. The brief will include a 2-sentence lay summary of root causes and a bullets list of steps we're taking to prevent recurrence.

carey: Also add a status history entry linking prior incidents so enterprise customers can track recurrence. We should surface dates and links to previous public briefs.

security-bot: Note: redaction workflow initiated. Please assign security reviewer.

lina: Assigning carey for legal + amir for security review. Action list: ben (status blurb) due in 1 hour; omar (customer brief template) due in 6 hours; carey (redaction checklist + start review) due in 24 hours; lina to approve final copy for status page after security signoff.

ben: Uploaded draft to the comms doc and tagged the channel. Will ping when live. :white_check_mark:

omar: Adding placeholder in postmortem action tracker with owners and due dates.

carey: Reminder to avoid technical jargon in the public brief. Keep the root-cause summary high level and focus on customer impact and mitigations.

lina: Thanks team. We'll regroup after the 24-hour brief is posted and confirm the RCA sharing plan.
